note: plupload_test is a demo/support submodule of plupload. Its only surface is one form (\Drupal\plupload_test\PluploadTestForm, form id _plupload_test_form) at route plupload.test => /plupload-test (requirement _access: 'TRUE', 'do not enable in production'). The form uses a #type 'plupload' element restricted to 'zip', validates status==='done', and moves finished temp files into <default_scheme>://plupload-test. It has no config/permissions/services/plugins of its own. Medium cases read back the shared plupload.settings temporary_uri that the demo stages chunks in, and confirm the demo route is registered. Hard cases: (1) enable the demo module so /plupload-test is live; (2) create the public://plupload-test destination directory the demo writes finished uploads into, verified on disk.

evals.prompt: The Drupal 'plupload_test' submodule ships a working example. At what URL path can I open its demo upload form, and what file extension does that form accept?
evals.expected_output: Visit /plupload-test (route plupload.test). The demo form restricts the plupload element to the 'zip' extension via #upload_validators.

evals.prompt: Which form class and form id does the plupload_test module provide as its example, and what upload pattern does its submit handler demonstrate?
evals.expected_output: Class \Drupal\plupload_test\PluploadTestForm, form id _plupload_test_form. Its submitForm() prepares a destination directory (<default_scheme>://plupload-test) and moves each finished plupload temp file (tmppath/name) there without creating File entities.

evals.prompt: Is it safe to leave the plupload_test module enabled on a production Drupal site? Why or why not?
evals.expected_output: No — it is a demo/test fixture. Its route plupload.test uses requirement _access: 'TRUE' (open to everyone) and its own routing file comments 'Do not enable in production'. Keep it disabled on production.

evals.prompt: On this site, where does the plupload_test demo form (/plupload-test) stage its in-progress upload chunks before they are moved? Inspect the live configuration and give the exact URI.
evals.expected_output: It stages chunks at the plupload temporary_uri, currently 'private://plupload_test_pt' (drush cget plupload.settings temporary_uri). The demo relies on the parent module's plupload.settings.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, is the plupload_test demo module currently providing its example form route, and what access requirement does that route carry? Inspect the running route table.
evals.expected_output: Yes — route plupload.test is registered at path /plupload-test with requirement _access: 'TRUE' (open access). Confirm via drush php:eval reading router.route_provider->getRouteByName('plupload.test').

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, make the plupload demo form available by enabling the plupload_test module, so that the route plupload.test at /plupload-test is live.
evals.expected_output: The plupload_test module is enabled (drush en plupload_test -y) and the route plupload.test resolves to path /plupload-test.

evals.prompt: The plupload_test demo form moves finished uploads into the directory public://plupload-test. On this site, create that destination directory so it exists and is writable (as the demo's submit handler would).
evals.expected_output: The directory public://plupload-test exists and is writable (e.g. via FileSystem::prepareDirectory($dir, CREATE_DIRECTORY | MODIFY_PERMISSIONS) with $dir passed as a variable).
